architecture.product_repo: KeepLab-Relay (backend/** plus the enumerated Android offline/conflict surface are writable in this milestone; everything else under app/ is read-only)
architecture.product_stack: Kotlin 2.3.21, Jetpack Compose + Material 3, Navigation 3, Hilt, Room 2.8.4 (KSP), AGP 9.2.1 — as extended by M2 with Ktor CIO, a Keystore-backed session store and one unique WorkManager `note_sync` pipeline; M3 extends it further only with offline-hardening and conflict-handling code and (if genuinely required) WorkManager test artifacts

new_packages: ui/conflict/** (the minimal conflict-resolution surface added by M3)
extended_packages: data/sync/** (bounded retry, manual retry, outbox durability, lost-wakeup protection, reconnect, coalescing, conflict application/resolution)
data/local/** (persisted conflict record entity + DAO, Trash timestamp, schema bump, outbox status fields required by bounded retry)
data/NoteRepository.kt (the single creation/update boundary plus the M3 conflict/Trash resolution entry points)
data/remote/** (M3 conflict payload on the 409 response, retry classification)

ui/settings/**, ui/navigation/**, ui/home/**, ui/note/**, ui/editor/**, ui/trash/**, ui/auth/** (tiny integration points only: sync-failed indicator, Retry sync, conflict indicator, reaching the conflict screen)
entry_points: KeepLabApplication.kt (only if an M3 wiring change is genuinely required)
MainActivity.kt (only if an M3 navigation integration point is genuinely required)
android_under_construction.tests: app/src/test/** (JVM only; no androidTest, no benchmark, no device)
android_under_construction.explicitly_absent_from_m3: attachments, binary upload/download, object storage, multi-device hardening, multi-account, collaboration, sharing, push provider, FCM, CRDT, automatic three-way text merge, account deletion, production cloud deployment, production email provider, Google/Firebase identity

backend_under_construction.location: KeepLab-Relay/backend/ (created by A2, extended by M2; PRESENT)
backend_under_construction.build_model: INDEPENDENT_GRADLE_PROJECT with its own backend/settings.gradle.kts and backend/build.gradle.kts
backend_under_construction.wrapper: the existing repository wrapper, reused as-is (Gradle 9.5.1)
backend_under_construction.stack: Kotlin 2.4.20 + Ktor 3.6.0 (Netty) · PostgreSQL via HikariCP + JDBC · Flyway migrations · portable Docker assets (untouched, not executed)
backend_under_construction.m3_additions: conflict response payload carrying the authoritative current revision and current server state for the conflicted entity; Trash timestamp field handling; final-delete/tombstone handling as required by M3; change-log semantics only as required by M3; new Flyway migrations after V3 (V4+) where a schema change is genuinely needed

architecture.stack_repo: Google-Android-Agent-Development-Stack (Specification Compiler, Verification Layer, Evaluation Core / Auto-Finalizer, Hermes orchestration kernel)
architecture.hermes: pinned vgit.af90026 (2026.9.24) at /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent; never upgraded, reinstalled or core-patched
architecture.guard: the same unmodified orchestration/hermes/evaluation_adapter/contract_guard.py, invoked by the same fail-closed pre_tool_call hook
architecture.note: M3 is a host-side backend + Android build/unit-test milestone. It provisions no cloud resource, uses no device, executes no Docker asset, and needs no live PostgreSQL.

m3_facts.a5_checkpoint: LIGHT — records only, never stops the session; the session continues directly into A6
m3_facts.room_schema: current 4 -> next clean version by direct experimental bump when M3 needs new local structures; DEV_DATABASE_RESET_REQUIRED = YES; no migration chain authored
m3_facts.tombstone_gc: DISABLED for M3; no tombstone retention duration is chosen; Trash != tombstone stays structural
m3_facts.server_revision: the only conflict authority; stale baseRevision -> 409 REVISION_CONFLICT carrying enough authoritative state to resolve
m3_facts.sign_out_policy: PRESERVE_LOCAL_CACHE (D-04) — non-destructive; AUTH_REQUIRED preserves Room rows, outbox, conflict records and checkpoint
m3_facts.single_pipeline: one serialized `note_sync` pipeline; a trigger arriving during an active sync must not be lost; the exact mechanism is an A5 implementation decision proven by deterministic tests against the actual WorkManager version
m3_facts.process_death: deterministic simulation only (persist Room state, destroy/recreate repository/worker objects, resume from the persisted outbox/checkpoint); no adb, no Maestro, no UiAutomator, no device
m3_facts.no_push: no push provider, no FCM, no background push architecture, no permanent background socket
m3_facts.no_cloud: no provisioning, no deployment, no cloud credential
m3_facts.no_device: no adb, no Maestro, no UiAutomator, no instrumentation, no APK install
m3_facts.live_postgres: not installed on this host -> LIVE_POSTGRES_INTEGRATION = SKIPPED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE; never a blocker; no infrastructure is installed inside M3 and the transactional semantics are not weakened

guard.package_switch_semantics: The guard resolves its package dir as os.environ['HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE'] or the built-in default. The hook subprocess inherits the Hermes process environment. Setting the variable for the Hermes process points the SAME unmodified guard at this package; no guard, hook or config change is involved.
guard.known_limitation: Hermes configuration, Hermes core and the hook allowlist live OUTSIDE the guard's source_root (/home/zhong/.hermes/...), so the guard's path lists cannot classify them. They are protected by an explicit hard prohibition and stop condition in this contract and in the M3 execution prompt, enforced by fail-closed operator discipline — not by the path list. Stated rather than hidden.
guard.write_intent_note: The guard's terminal write-intent extractor reads a literal '>' anywhere in a shell command as a redirect (MB-A1-003 / MB-A2-008 / MB-M2-006). Drive the guard by files and read-only commands; never inline heredocs or payload-bearing shell text.

contract_notes.supersedes: nothing; the frozen P0B-CLOSE contract and the A0/A1/A2/M2 contract packages remain active and unedited
